[1] faq.md > Can I pick my order up instead?
### Do you ship fuel to Canada?

No. Clearburn white gas, lamp oil and kerosene ship by ground only inside the United States, and
never to Canada, Alaska, Hawaii or a PO box. If a Canadian order contains fuel, we remove the fuel
and refund it before the rest of the order ships.

### Can I pick my order up instead?

Yes, at the Frederick showroom only. Choose curbside pickup at checkout and your order is ready
within 2 hours during store hours, Monday through Saturday 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Pickup is free.
The Annapolis showroom does not offer curbside pickup.

### My package says delivered but I don't have it. What now?

Check with neighbors and your building's office first; most packages turn up within a day. If it
has not arrived 10 business days after the expected delivery date, write to us with the order
number and we will ship a replacement before the carrier claim is settled.

[2] shipping.md > Curbside pickup
Fuel-burning lanterns that have never had fuel in them are ordinary goods and ship by any
service. A fueled lantern, for example one coming back for repair, must be fully drained and
aired out before it ships; the Repair Center's instructions cover this.

Lithium-ion products (the Firefly 220R, Sentinel 1000 and Sentinel 1000 Pro) ship under the
carrier's battery-in-equipment rules and need no special handling by the customer. They do not
ship by USPS to Alaska or Hawaii; the warehouse uses UPS Ground for those destinations.

## Curbside pickup

Curbside pickup is available at the Frederick showroom only, at 412 East Patrick Street. It is
free and orders are ready within 2 hours of being placed during showroom hours (Monday to
Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM ET). An order placed after 4:00 PM is ready the next morning.
The customer receives a "ready for pickup" email, parks in the loading zone on East Patrick
Street and calls the showroom; staff bring the order out. Pickup orders are held for 7 days,
after which they are cancelled and refunded.

The Annapolis showroom does not offer curbside pickup; its stock is not connected to the online
store's inventory. Customers near Annapolis can order online and have the order shipped, or buy
from the showroom floor.

Fuel may be collected curbside, which is the simplest way for a Frederick customer to buy it.

[3] faq.md > Can I return something at a showroom?
### I got it as a holiday gift. Is the return period longer?

Yes. Any order delivered between November 1 and December 24 can be returned until January 31.

### Can I return something at a showroom?

Yes, at either the Frederick or the Annapolis showroom. Bring the packing slip or the order number
and the showroom will process the return on the spot.

## Warranty and repairs

[4] showrooms.md > Services
### Parking and directions

Street parking on Compromise Street and around the City Dock is metered, two hours maximum, and
scarce on summer weekends. The Hillman Garage on Duke of Gloucester Street, a four-minute walk, is
the fallback; we do not validate there. The Circulator trolley stops at the City Dock.

From Route 50, take exit 24 for Rowe Boulevard, continue to College Avenue, then King George
Street and Randall Street to the dock; Compromise Street runs along the water. Boaters tying up at
the City Dock are a short walk away, and many of our Annapolis customers arrive that way.

### Services

Repair drop-off: bring the lantern to the register. We open the repair ticket and hold the lantern
in the back room. Annapolis repairs are shipped to the Hagerstown Repair Center once a week, on
Tuesdays, so an Annapolis drop-off takes about a week longer than one in Frederick. Fuel lanterns
must be empty; Annapolis has no drain tray, so please empty the lantern at home first.

There is no curbside pickup at Annapolis, and no wick-trimming clinic. Online orders cannot be
collected here. Customers who want to collect an order should choose Curbside pickup, Frederick, or
have it shipped.

In-store returns are accepted with the packing slip or the order number, and no RA number is
needed.

### What is stocked

The Annapolis showroom leans toward what people on and around the water buy: the Sentinel 1000
and Sentinel 1000 Pro, the Firefly 220 and Firefly 220R, the Beacon 600, the Hagerstown Kerosene
Lantern in galvanized and black, the Heritage No. 7 and the Porchlight Solar. It does not stock the
Northstar Dual-Fuel on the floor, though it can be ordered for shipping, and it carries Clearburn
lamp oil and kerosene but not Clearburn white gas. Mantles, wicks and chimneys are stocked; globes
are ordered. No Second Light items.

[5] shipping.md > Rates and delivery times
## Scope

This document covers how Lantern Supply Co. ships orders from the Hagerstown warehouse, what the
customer pays, how long delivery takes, what can and cannot be shipped where, and what to do when
a package goes wrong. Customer service agents quote from it; the online store's shipping page is
derived from it. Internal transfers between the warehouse and the showrooms are covered in the
last section.

## Rates and delivery times

All orders ship from the warehouse at 1180 Downsville Pike, Hagerstown, MD 21740. Delivery times
are in business days (Monday to Friday, excluding the six company holidays) and count from the
day the order leaves the warehouse, not the day it was placed.

| Service   | Cost                             | Delivery time         | Same-day cutoff |
|-----------|----------------------------------|-----------------------|-----------------|
| Standard  | $6.95, free on orders of $75 or more | 3 to 6 business days | 2:00 PM ET    |
| Expedited | $14.95                           | 2 business days       | 2:00 PM ET      |
| Overnight | $29.95                           | Next business day     | 1:00 PM ET      |
| Canada    | $19.95 flat                      | 5 to 10 business days | 2:00 PM ET      |

Standard shipping is free on orders with a merchandise subtotal of $75 or more, calculated after
discounts and before tax. Fuel and oversized items count toward the subtotal. Orders under $75
pay the flat $6.95. Expedited and overnight are never free, though Flame and Beacon tier Lumen
Rewards members receive free upgrades from standard to expedited under the terms of that program.

Overnight service is available only to addresses in the contiguous 48 states and only for orders
placed by 1:00 PM ET on a business day. An overnight order placed on a Friday before the cutoff is
delivered on Monday.
